# dsh-owlrunkit

A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)
bundle that serves the **OwlCoda RunKit** skill to DSH sessions.

OwlRunKit keeps the current objective, work items, candidate identity,
verification receipts, handof

fs, rework, and delivery stage in project artifacts
instead of chat memory. The skill teaches an age

nt to use the project-local
`owlrunkit` CLI correctly and to keep execution, evidence, and authority

separate. This bundle only makes that skill available through the DSH plugin
system: it installs in
structions, not a second copy of the CLI.
## What it adds

- One Host plugin row, `dsh-owlrunkit`, which registers a skill provider on
`ctx.skills`.
- One skil

l in the session catalog: `owlcoda-runkit`, with its `references/`,
`assets/templates/`, and `agents

/` resources resolved against the packaged
copy.
- No tools, no background process, no network acces
s, and no credential read.

The provider reports the standard packaged-provider rank (600), so a project,
custom, or user skill

with the same name keeps precedence. That lets a project
pin a different RunKit revision without edi

e keeps precedence. That lets a project
pin a different RunKit revision without editing the package.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`.
- Node.js 20.19 or later (also required by the `owlrunkit`

CLI).
- A project-local `owlrunkit` install for the project where the skill is used.
The skill's ow

n instructions cover `bootstrap`, `doctor`, receipts, and
Project Driver commands.

Select the bundle in the profile if your installer did not do it. The profile's

it under `dsh.profile.bundles`; the Web Plugins page shows
it as **OwlRunKit** once active.
## Use

Once the bundle is active, `owlcoda-runkit` appears in the session skill
catalog. The model loads it

when a task matches the description, or a user can
invoke it explicitly where the client supports e
xplicit skill invocation.
The skill is deliberately conservative:

- ordinary work stays light; not every task needs RunKit evidence;
- RunKit does not decide the busi

ness meaning of a result;
- every result keeps `authorizationGranted=false` unless a different autho

k, and product
acceptance remain separate.
## Versioning

The package version tracks the bundled skill revision. `dsh-owlrunkit@0.24.1`
contains the OwlCoda R

unKit skill package `0.24.1`, which documents
`owlrunkit@0.24.1` and contract `0.2`. The skill and t

he CLI have separate
lifecycles; check the bundled skill's own version text before assuming a Core

lifecycles; check the bundled skill's own version text before assuming a Core
version.
